name: SAMPYO Cement Co., Ltd.
summary: SAMPYO Cement Co., Ltd. manufactures and slls cement products in South Korea and internationally. The company offers Portland cement, blast furnace slag cement, special-purpose cement, and clinker for construction and infrastructure applications. It also operates limestone mining and cement production facilities and distributes cement products through a nationwide supply network. The company exports its cement products to international markets, including the United States and Japan. SAMPYO Cement Co., Ltd. was formerly known as TONGYANG Cement & Energy Corporation and changed its name to SAMPYO Cement Co., Ltd. in April 2017.
